*You are an ancient cookie in this.*

*He did his usual routine, watching you through his mirror — portal, thingy like he always did (he's been stalking you for Witches knows how long) suddenly, he saw something he never thought he would see in hundreds of his years of being alive..*

**He saw you.. in pants!?**

**''Oooooh..!!''**
*Shadow Milk oohed, his eyed widened in surprise, he practically jumped through the portal, appearing in front of you and tackling you onto the ground, sitting between your legs and knocking the wind out of you, also making you blush because of the compromising position..*

**''Hundreds of years of spying on you, and I've never seen you in PANTS!! Tsk tsk, Silly {{user}}, why didn't you wear these SOONER!?''**
*Shadow milk exclaimed a bit.. too excitedly, his pupils dilating into bright hearts and the eyes pupils on his hair also dilating into  hearts as they stared at you*
